title: "random_forest"
output: html_document
---

```{r}

library(ISLR)
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)
library(tidyverse)
library(randomForest)
library(dplyr)
library(ranger)
library(pROC)


bev_cols <- c("Low_alcohol_beer","Mid_strength_beer","Full_strength_beer",
              "White_wine","Red_wine","Low_alcohol_wine",
              "Champagne_sparkling_wine","Spirits_RTD","Liqueurs",
              "Spirits","Fortified_wine","Cider","Cocktails")

rf_data <- df_filter %>%
  mutate(
    CKD_factor = factor(CKD, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No_CKD", "CKD")),
    SEX_factor = factor(SEX_factor, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Male", "Female")),
  ) %>%
  select(-CKD, -SEX) %>%   # drop the raw versions so they don't leak into the model
  na.omit()

#Need to fix class imbalance

table(train$CKD_factor) / nrow(train)   # check class imbalance

set.seed(123)
idx   <- sample(nrow(rf_data), 0.7 * nrow(rf_data))
train <- rf_data[idx, ]
test  <- rf_data[-idx, ]

train_maj <- train %>% filter(CKD_factor == "No_CKD")
train_min <- train %>% filter(CKD_factor == "CKD")

train_up <- bind_rows(
  train_maj,
  train_min[sample(nrow(train_min), nrow(train_maj), replace = TRUE), ]
)

table(train_up$CKD_factor)   # should now be balanced

rf <- randomForest(
  CKD_factor ~ .,
  data = train_up,
  ntree = 500,
  importance = TRUE
)

# Evaluate on the untouched test set
pred_class <- predict(rf, test)
pred_prob  <- predict(rf, test, type = "prob")[, "CKD"]

table(Predicted = pred_class, Actual = test$CKD_factor)
auc(roc(test$CKD_factor, pred_prob))

importance(rf)     # MeanDecreaseAccuracy = permutation importance
varImpPlot(rf)

tree <- rpart(CKD_factor ~ ., data = train_up, method = "class",
              control = rpart.control(cp = 0.005, minbucket = 30))
rpart.plot(tree)



```
